nodes.label: Indonesian Tax Exception Rule
nodes.rationale: Listed transaction fees exclude applicable Indonesian taxes except QRIS and ShopeePay.

nodes.label: CIMB Refund Exception
nodes.rationale: CIMB differs from other listed QRIS issuers by not supporting full refunds within 24 hours while supporting full refunds after 24 hours and partial refunds.

nodes.label: Direct Deduction
nodes.rationale: Under direct deduction, transaction fees are deducted from the account that receives the transaction.

nodes.label: Indirect Billing
nodes.rationale: Managed sub-accounts pay after a billing statement is issued, while owned sub-account indirect billing is paid by the platform.
